description: OS packages the deploy tools need on the machine that runs them, installed from the OS vendor's signed package archive (or the site's mirror of it). One list: deploy/keys/new-dev-site-key.sh reads the package names from it, and the fit check reads it as host resources (48.1-06). Keep each package's packageNames and usedBy on one line each; the script reads them with awk.

packages.name: softhsm2
packages.purpose: SoftHSM2, a software PKCS#11 token that holds the organization site key during development (owner decision a, 2026-11-24); a production site uses its own HSM instead and refuses a SoftHSM2 signing token

packages.name: opensc
packages.purpose: OpenSC's pkcs11-tool, which makes the site key inside the token and runs the private-key operation (C_Sign) on its PKCS#11 URI; cosign does the payload, attach and verify steps

packages.name: util-linux script
packages.purpose: script(1), which runs pkcs11-tool on a terminal of its own so OpenSC's PIN prompt works while new-dev-site-key.sh reads the new key's Access line from its output; in the base install of Ubuntu (bsdutils, essential) and RHEL (util-linux)
packages.licence: BSD-4-Clause-UC (script); util-linux as a whole GPL-2.0-or-later
